name: marinara-engine
description: AI Chat & Roleplay Frontend — Conversation, Roleplay, Game
author: Marianna

scripts.build: pnpm clean:stale-client && pnpm --filter @marinara-engine/shared build && pnpm --filter @marinara-engine/server --filter @marinara-engine/client --parallel run build
scripts.check: pnpm clean:stale-client && pnpm impeccable:check && pnpm localization:check && pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm build
scripts.regression:prompt: pnpm build:shared && node ./scripts/run-regressions.mjs --filter scripts/regressions/prompt.regression.ts && node ./scripts/run-regressions.mjs --filter scripts/regressions/prompt-attachments.regression.ts && node ./scripts/run-regressions.mjs --filter scripts/regressions/context-fit.regression.ts
scripts.regression:noodle: pnpm build:shared && node ./scripts/run-regressions.mjs --filter scripts/regressions/noodle/deletion.regression.ts && node ./scripts/run-regressions.mjs --filter scripts/regressions/noodle/feed-seen.regression.ts && node ./scripts/run-regressions.mjs --filter scripts/regressions/noodle/image-claim.regression.ts && node ./scripts/run-regressions.mjs --filter scripts/regressions/noodle/mentions.regression.ts && node ./scripts/run-regressions.mjs --filter scripts/regressions/noodle/platform-migration.regression.ts && node ./scripts/run-regressions.mjs --filter scripts/regressions/noodle/polls.regression.ts && node ./scripts/run-regressions.mjs --filter scripts/regressions/slurp-storage.regression.ts
scripts.regression:security: pnpm build:shared && node ./scripts/run-regressions.mjs --filter security && node ./scripts/run-regressions.mjs --filter runtime-integrity && node ./scripts/run-regressions.mjs --filter shell-sandbox && node ./scripts/run-regressions.mjs --filter extension-ipc && node ./scripts/run-regressions.mjs --filter android-local-auth && node ./scripts/run-regressions.mjs --filter docker-proxy-auth
scripts.regression:launcher-update: node ./scripts/regressions/pnpm-runner.regression.mjs && node ./scripts/regressions/launcher/env.regression.mjs && node ./scripts/regressions/launcher/existing-server.regression.mjs && node ./scripts/regressions/launcher/update.regression.mjs && node ./scripts/regressions/dev-launcher-process.regression.mjs && node ./scripts/regressions/launcher/format-guard.regression.mjs && node ./scripts/check-windows-installer-layout.mjs
